prompt: A new song leaning heavily on the vocals of one song: pull the Lights in the Sky vocal stems from the sound store, follow the order and spacing of its vocal sections, loop and chop freely, keep near the original tempo. Not a remake and not a remix of that record's other sounds.

requests.ask: go get the vocals from strudel-pack for lights-in-the-sky, understand the order and general spacing between each vocal section, write a new song using those vocals in the right general order, but looping and chopping is ok

changes.why: borrowed 16 vocal phrase clips (voc_ph_001..032) from lights-in-the-sky into samples/user/low-orbit-cuts; nothing else from that record
cps 110/240: the source is 55 bpm, doubled so the kit can move while the pulse is the record's, felt half-time
key C:minor, read off the clips' own pitch medians (117-132 Hz in the verses, 147-178 in the choruses: Bb C D Eb F)
one low verse fragment on bar 5, the way the record waits three bars before its first word
the record's verse-1 shape: two fragments, a seven-bar hole, two more
no voice at all: the six-bar hole inside the source verse kept as an instrumental section
the chorus-1 shape, a fragment every other bar and a fifth higher than the verse ones
two fragments at the top, the record's eight-bar silence, one lead-in
the chorus-2 shape, a fragment nearly every bar: the densest thing on the record and here
one 2.5 s fragment cut into eight and played as an instrument, so its syllables stop being words
the two fragments that overrun the record's End marker, alone with their tails

requests.ask: this does not have all the vocals i would expect, and the general order matters

changes.why: all 33 vocal phrase clips now play, not the 16 loudest: the makeup-gain table makes the quiet ones usable (clip 3, 6, 8 and 21 sit near -46 dB rms and need 11-13x)
added three bar-exact chunks of the same vocal stem (l2_001, l2_002, l4_001) as sustained voice: the l4 fills hold, an l2 sits under each chorus
order is now a rule the check can verify: first appearance runs 1..33 strictly ascending, repeats only echo forward inside their own cluster
the chop moved from clip 30 to clip 15: a chop of a chorus-2 clip sounded at bar 1, before the sequence reached it, which broke the order; 15 was already heard whole in lift, so it is a callback
and flood.sample2 the held stem chunks panned -0.35, left, opposite the chop (the mix lint called three parts at centre a flat stage)

requests.ask: whats going on when you do 456,789... you smoosh them together?

changes.why: the opposite was happening: every fragment had its own bar, 2.18 s apart, always. Six of the 33 clips are the tail of the one before (the transcriber split one sung line in two, they overlap 0.2 s on the record) with real gaps of 1.08-1.94 s, so a whole bar between them pulled one line into two events
a slot may now be [n, m], two clips sharing a bar with m 1.64 s behind n: pairs 2-3, 5-6, 20-21, 23-24, 25-26, 27-28

every placement rewritten at the record's own scale instead of one-per-bar; most consecutive gaps now land within 15 percent of the source, the exceptions being the two long silences (28 s and 35 s) compressed to about 11 s each to fit a three-minute song
all echoes dropped: each fragment is heard once, where the record puts it. The echoes were what made the spacing arbitrary in the first place
fragment 15 moved from bar 13 to bar 15: it ends 0.1 s before fragment 16 begins on the record, and three empty bars after it stretched that seam to 8.7 s (now 4.4)

requests.ask: does this help you in any way understand the vocal clips? [waveform of the whole voc stem]

changes.why: the stem waveform prompted a coverage check: the 33 phrase clips account for only 19 percent of the stem's 231 s, and the activity detector finds voice in three windows the transcript is empty for (100.4 s, 148.4 s, 192.0 s)
the chunk at 148.4 s sits in the middle of the 34 s stretch treated here as the record's silence; it is not silent there, so that chunk is now the voice in the hole, wordless
the chunk at 100.4 s placed in the gap between fragments 14 and 15
the chunk at 192.0 s placed in the gap between fragments 26 and 27

requests.ask: do you think you are using all the vocals you know of in the right order?

changes.why: audited all 44 clips of the vocal stem against their position here: the answer on order was no. Two inversions, both from the held chunks, which were sample parts and so looped from the top of their section
removed the four-bar held chunk: its window is 87.3 s, inside the first chorus, so it played chorus material before any chorus fragment and contained three of them bodily
and flood removed the two-bar held chunks: each is a window already covered by fragments played here, so placing them in order would have doubled those fragments a second apart
gain 3 to 4.5: it measured 20.2 dB under the mix as the only voice in that stretch, which is background for a part with nothing beside it
five stem chunks stay unused on purpose, each a bar containing a phrase already played; the pack is re-exported to the 36 clips the song plays

requests.ask: open raw3 first sound should be a beat earlier; verse1 raw3 first sound bad, second is 2 sounds and sounds bad, last cropped oddly; lift raw3 first 3 bad; verse2 raw3 4th bad; flood and out raw3 all bad - like unwanted trimming/looping on raw3

changes.why: every fragment now gates itself: note-off before its own buffer ends with a release of the same length, so the hard edge where the transcriber cut it becomes a fade. Nothing closed the gate before, so short clips stopped dead with seconds of open gate after them
the fade is a third of the clip up to .3 s, not fixed: a fixed fade was two thirds of a half-second syllable

makeup gain capped at 6: normalising the four quietest clips wanted 12-15x, which lifts the stem noise floor 22 dB with the voice. Final gains top out at 8.4 not 15.2, and the part still measures 11.2 dB under the mix in verse1
removed the chopped part: it fired 0.27 s grains of one clip 80 times in the section, the loudest thing there, and was the looping that was heard
the first word is a pickup on the last beat of the bar before, written as a negative slot

requests.ask: melody on hold and lift and flood is too loud or shrill; then: increase the vocal density, he kind of sounds like he is mumbling so lean into that, mumble more to himself; make new parts we can easily turn off

changes.why: hook register .72>.62 level .9>.65 brightness .55>.4 space .55>.62: it measured 9.6 dB under the mix in hold with an 1830 Hz centroid and nothing above 3 kHz, so it was not bright but sitting in the upper mids where a vibraphone pierces. verse2 already had it at .62 and was never the shrill one
and lift.melody and flood.melody now 12.5 and 14.2 and 15.0 dB under the mix, centroid 1066 Hz, depth about .6
added a mumble part per section (raw5): in every bar the lead leaves empty it repeats whatever last sounded, off the beat, three semitones down, under a 900 Hz low-pass
the mumble is derived from the lead's own sequence so it can only say something the lead has already reached: 0 inversions still, all 33 ascending; vocal events 37 to 79
MUMBLE = false at the top removes every mumble part in one edit, and each section's is its own part so the page's mute takes one off alone

requests.ask: we dont need that const, we will just do agentically. the mumbles i have seen them but dont really hear them, and i didnt mean a specific mumble, i meant just more and more of the things he is saying on that section

changes.why: removed the MUMBLE const: parts come out by editing them out

the second vocal part was built as a separate effect (three semitones down, 900 Hz low-pass, gains at 30 percent) and measured 22.7 dB under the mix against the lead's 11.3: visible in the event stream, not in the room
it is now the same clips at the same makeup gains, no filter and no pitch shift, cycling through every fragment the section has already sounded
every other empty bar takes two fragments rather than one; vocal events 37 to 79 to 98
measures 13.8 dB under the mix against the lead's 11.4, centroid 369 Hz against 404: the same voice at nearly the same level

requests.ask: more more overlap raw5; i want an almost constant mumble, like a conversation i cannot quite hear

changes.why: every bar is four quarter-note slots: an empty one takes three fragments on beats 2, 3 and 4, a lead bar takes one clear of the lead's own hit. Slots are .545 s apart and fragments run .5 to 3.3 s, so two or three sound at once
the overlap is what makes it unintelligible rather than quiet: voices masking each other stop resolving into words while staying present, which the 900 Hz low-pass and 22 dB drop failed to do
each slot takes one of four speeds and one of four pans in turn, under a 2.8 kHz low-pass, so it reads as a few people across a room rather than one mouth
hold carries verse1's clips forward so it can talk where the stem is empty; replaying only what has already sounded keeps the order safe
level .75>.25: at .75 the density measured it 10.4 dB under the mix against the lead's 11.6, in front of the voice it sits behind; at .25 it is 19.6 under, 8.3 under the lead, depth .86

requests.ask: melody on hold, lift, verse2, flood is still too loud or shrill; try again

changes.why: the previous register .62>.5 was a no-op: melodyOctave in lib/layers.mjs is a three-way step (octave 3 below 1/3, 4 up to 2/3, 5 above), so the pitch had not moved since .72>.62

hook register .3: octave 3, verified from the events as midi 48..63 instead of 60..72. The line ran C4 to C5 at 3.5 notes a cycle, which reads as shrill whatever the level, and its centroid (1066 Hz, nothing above 3 kHz) never showed it
hook notes thinned to four with air between them, articulation .5>.65 so each hit stops ringing into the next
hook level .5>.8: the octave drop, shorter clip and thinner line together over-corrected to 24.2 dB under the mix in lift

melody now 19.3 / 20.1 / 20.0 / 20.8 dB under the mix in hold / lift / verse2 / flood, centroid 708 Hz, against 9.6 to 12.4 dB and 1830 Hz originally; masking with the guitar it now shares a range with measures 0.06 in the mids

requests.ask: verse1 raw5 needs to be slightly louder; i dont like how you fully removed the shrill melody, its all gone now; sounds good in flood now and hold; hold, lift and flood drums part needs to be 80% of its value or intensity

changes.why: hook the octave was the fix and the rest was over-correction: the written line and articulation are back exactly as they were, register stays .3, level .8>1. hold/lift/flood melody now 13.6 / 14.4 / 15.0 dB under the mix at 702 Hz, against 9.6 / 11.3 / 12.4 when it was shrill and 19.3 / 20.1 / 20.8 when it was gone
level .25>.35: 19.6 dB under the mix to 16.7, against that section's lead at 11.3
level .6>.48, lift.drums level .75>.6 (the kit's own, inherited through kitFull), flood.drums level .62>.5: 80 percent each
all three read transients touch full scale afterwards at 0.001 to 0.002 percent of samples, the soft clip's category rather than a level problem

requests.ask: lift and flood kit is way too loud, like nothing changed; also make raw2 half as loud, too much fuzz; change vibraphones to pianos

changes.why: level .6>.28 and flood.drums .5>.23: 80 percent was only -1.9 dB and the kit carried about 45 percent of the mix energy, so lowering it lowered the mix with it and the ratio moved 1.7 dB. Halving is -6 dB and moves the ratio about 4
kit against the mix went -3.5>-7.8 in lift and -2.7>-6.7 in flood; against the lead vocal, which does not move, +8.2>+1.6 and +7.0>-0.1

hook sound vibraphone>piano; level 1>.72 because the piano samples are louder and the same level put it at 11.2 dB under the mix where the vibraphone sat at 14.4 and sounded right. Now 13.9 in lift and 14.1 in flood, centroid 702>399 Hz
bed gain .55>.28, half as asked; it lands 30 dB under the mix, which the mix lint calls inaudible

requests.ask: do to the kit in hold as you did to lift

changes.why: level .48>.22, the same halving lift got: kit against the mix -4.5>-9.0 dB, against the bass +1.0>-3.5, against the conversation bed +8.9>+4.4

requests.ask: i want to be clear, i think it works if the drums sound level is x0.1; im not sure what you are changing

changes.why: the only thing changed in any of these kit passes is one number per section: the level on that section's drums line. Templates, density, variation and samples are untouched
drums level now verse1 .08, hold .1, lift .1, verse2 .075, flood .1, from .6 / .6 / .75 / .55 / .62 originally
the verses scale with the rest: left where they were, a verse kick would be six times the amplitude of a chorus kick and the verses would be the drummiest thing in the song

kit against the mix is now -19.1 in verse1, -15.9 in lift, -13.1 in flood; against the bass -14.0 / -10.4 / -8.1; the arc still rises into the climax because it is carried by the templates and density, not level

requests.ask: on verse1 and verse2 make perc 0.1; on lift make perc2 = 0.1; you can vary them like 10% for a nice feel, or not

changes.why: level .3>.1: the open hat measured 12.3 dB under the mix against a kit at 15.9, louder than the kit under it; now 20.5
and verse2.perc the verses had no perc part at all, so the shaker was added to both at .24 and .22, a tenth apart

level multiplies a sample's own loudness, so .1 is not the same amount on every part: .1 on the 808 shaker measured 32.3 and 33.6 dB under the mix, which the lint calls inaudible, where .1 on the LinnDrum kit is a quiet kit. .24 and .22 put the shakers at 24.6 and 25.8

requests.ask: that was a bad note, i meant on verse1 and verse2 make drums 0.1 not perc

changes.why: and verse2.perc removed: the shakers went in on a misread and were never asked for
level .08>.1 and verse2.drums .075>.09, the two a touch apart; the kit now runs .1 in every section but verse2, measuring 17.1 and 17.5 dB under the mix in the verses against a bass at 5

requests.ask: i altered drums and fx manually. do a final mix, im hearing some clipping and your mix will fix it. make the default visual orrery with the occasional sediment

changes.why: visual orrery with sediment breathing over it every 16 bars, in place of tunnel and combo
the whole-song render peaked 0.916 with zero clipped samples: not digital clipping but the page's soft clip, identity to 0.8 and tanh above, working audibly on the peaks
compressors on the shaker and the voice were tried and reverted: measured, they raised each part's rms 1-3 dB and left the peaks, taking the whole-song peak to 0.980
shaker level .65>.4: it sat at -17 dB rms but peaked 0.657, the loudest single peak in lift and flood
makeup gain cap 6>4.5: the seven capped fragments were the voice's peaks
clip 5 gain 4>2.5: at 4 it was the largest single peak in the song, 0.744 in verse1; now 0.465
impact level .55>.4: peaked 0.501
raw2 (the noise bed) cut from every section: halved on request it measured 30 dB under the mix, inaudible by the lint, while tripping masking warnings against the pad and the guitar
section peaks now flood 0.731 lift 0.543 verse2 0.612 verse1 0.500, all under the 0.8 knee; the whole-song render 0.916>0.855

the 4.5 gain cap applied to every entry this time: the first pass only lowered the ones that read exactly 6, leaving 9 at 5.13, 18 at 5.18, 28 at 6 and 33 at 5.91. Clip 28 at 6 x the climax's 1.4 part level was the one moment in the whole render over the soft clip's knee, flood bar 10.80, three 10 ms blocks; now 6.3 final gain, from 8.4

requests.ask: it can now load (the confirming render)

changes.why: the confirming whole-song render, real this time (wav timestamp checked): the previous 0.858 at flood bar 10.80 was the pair [27, 28], 27 runs 2.14 s so it is still sounding when 28 lands three quarters through the bar and they stack. Clips 27 and 28 gain 3.96 and 4.5 to 3 each, final 4.2 in the event stream
impact level .4>.3: the downbeat measured 0.804 with it at .4

whole-song render: no 10 ms block over the soft clip's 0.8 knee, true sample peak 0.776 at lift bar 7.29, analyzer peak 0.713, clipped 0, rms -21.1 dBFS unchanged from before the pass, so nothing got quieter, only the peaks came off
